overview: Euclid DR1 dominated: CNN/ViT ensembles, citizen science and expert grading produced a 15,072-candidate strong-lens catalogue, with segmentation and bias studies. Simulation-based inference with normalizing flows and flow matching targeted DES Y3 shear, LISA binaries, gravitational-wave tests of general relativity and FRB cosmology; neural surrogates emulated MHD turbulence, supernova equations of state and Lyman-alpha forests. New benchmarks and releases include COSMIO cross-survey imputation, the FAIR Universe weak-lensing challenge, Survey of Surveys DR3, EuclidFM, and differentiable galpy backends.
themes: Euclid DR1 strong-lens detection and segmentation
ML benchmarks, catalogues and open tools
